test_validate_content_size: test the _validate_content_size function to verify it rejects content exceeding 100,000 characters and returns an error message with limit details
test_skill_manage_create: test the skill_manage create action to verify it accepts skill content within the 100,000 character limit and rejects oversized content
test_skill_manage_edit: test the skill_manage edit action to verify it rejects editing a skill to content that exceeds the 100,000 character limit
test_skill_manage_patch: test the skill_manage patch action to verify it checks the resulting file size after patching and rejects patches that would exceed the limit
test_skill_manage_write_file: test the skill_manage write_file action to verify it enforces both character and byte size limits on supporting files
test_skill_view_handplaced: test the skill_view function to verify it loads hand-placed skills from disk without applying the 100,000 character size limit
